quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that `content`'s structural markers (imperative numbered steps vs. goal-oriented steps vs. lookup tables vs. discursive prose) match the declared `quadrant`, per the spec's own `recomputation` rule
quality_bar.verified_source: Diataxis, 'The four modes' — https://diataxis.fr/#the-four-modes-of-documentation (primary source; each quadrant is defined by its own distinct structural form, which is the criterion's own basis for classification).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: for a `tutorial` quadrant entry, does the doc teach through a concrete guided exercise the learner completes, rather than describing how to accomplish a real-world task?
quality_bar.verified_source: Diataxis, 'Tutorials' — https://diataxis.fr/tutorials/ (primary source; Diataxis explicitly distinguishes a tutorial's learning-oriented exercise from a how-to guide's task-oriented steps, the exact confusion this checklist item guards against).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: for a `reference` quadrant entry, is the content structured as accurate, austere description (no explanatory digression, no instructional narrative) mirroring the thing it describes?
quality_bar.verified_source: Diataxis, 'Reference' — https://diataxis.fr/reference/ (primary source; Diataxis states reference material's own governing property is austerity and structural correspondence to the product, distinct from explanation's discursive form).

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that a single `doc_id` is not simultaneously tagged as satisfying more than one quadrant's structural markers (e.g. a how-to guide with embedded conceptual digressions)
quality_bar.verified_source: Diataxis, 'Compass' — https://diataxis.fr/compass/ (primary source; Diataxis's own map states each quadrant is exclusive along its two axes (acquisition/application, cognition/action), and mixing them is the standard's named anti-pattern).

quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: quadrant is exclusive per Diataxis — a doc belongs to exactly one quadrant, recomputed by re-classifying content against the quadrant's own structural markers, never asserted standalone.

reference_resolution.rule: doc_id must resolve to an actual documentation file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

use_when.board_condition: new user-facing documentation is proposed on the branch AND no technical-writing record exists yet for that doc_id
